name: Viceroy Los Cabos
positioning: Minimalist, architect-designed beach resort on the Sea of Cortez in San José del Cabo
best_for: Design lovers who want a modernist beach resort
Families and groups wanting villas with up to five bedrooms
Golfers who want several courses within a short drive

facts.text: The resort is in San José del Cabo, Mexico.
The resort sits about 20 minutes from Los Cabos International Airport (SJD).
The resort is just minutes from San José del Cabo's old town of markets, art and quiet streets.
The resort opened as Mar Adentro before Viceroy took it over.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and private outdoor space.
In-room tech lets guests control lighting, music and drapes at the touch of a finger.
The villas are modernist spaces with configurations for up to five bedrooms.
The fitness center was designed in collaboration with Harley Pasternak.
An intimate on-property theater has daily screenings for guests and can be reserved for private screenings.
NIDO serves omakase fare in The Nest, a lattice-like structure.

highlights.text: The resort was designed by Mexico City-based architect Miguel Ángel Aragonés, trading palapas and artisanal tile for minimalism.
Glass-and-concrete structures seem to almost float above the resort's saltwater pools.
The resort sits along the edge of the Sea of Cortez with miles of white sand beach.
THE SPA has signature vitality pools, thermal rooms and a grotto.
The resort has an infinity-edge beachfront pool.

considerations.text: Golf is played off-site, at courses within 20 minutes of the resort.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
